description: This is a C++ source file implementing a fuzzing test for the quic::QuicFramer component, specifically testing the processing of data packets in the quiche QUIC implementation. It includes functions to generate packet headers, set up the framer, and perform fuzz testing by serializing and processing packets with randomized data.

classes.name: QuicSelfContainedPacketHeader
classes.description: A specialized QuicPacketHeader with built-in storage for diversification nonce.

classes.name: FuzzingFramerVisitor
classes.description: A custom framer visitor that counts successful header processing and decryption events during fuzzing.

methods.name: ConsumePacketHeaderFormat
methods.description: Determines the packet header format (long or short) based on the version and provider input.

methods.name: ConsumeParsedQuicVersion
methods.description: Generates a random ParsedQuicVersion from predefined versions.

methods.name: ConsumeQuicPacketHeader
methods.description: Constructs a randomized QuicSelfContainedPacketHeader for fuzz testing.

methods.name: SetupFramer
methods.description: Initializes a QuicFramer with visitor, encrypters, and decrypters based on version.
